title: EE60022: Power Systems Transients And Protection
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Transients in lumped parameter and distributed parameter circuits-wave
equations; Multi-conductor systems, switching surge studies -Dommels method,
EMTP. Frequency domain approach. Surge response of transformers. Overvoltage
mitigation. Surge Arresters. Insulation co-ordination.
Philosophy of power system protection, Relaying Instrumentation-characteristics
of CT and PT. Overview of computer relaying, hardware organization, Algorithm
development, Applications, Integration to substation function, Adaptive
protection philosophy.
